clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal Glades, candles from Gunther's island are bound for a grim test. A crate on Gunther's Retreat holds the ritual tapers Gunther Arcanus uses to test allegiance.
Gunther asks you to take a candle from the crate on Gunther's Retreat to the old, bloody altar off the island's southern coast. Light it there, and face Lillith Nefara, the Scourge agent.

A crate of candles rests on Gunther's Retreat, the island in Brightwater Lake where Gunther Arcanus dwells. For his test in Proving Allegiance, one candle is enough. Lit on the old, bloody altar off the island's southern coast, it awakens Lillith Nefara, the Scourge agent.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
